$description: saves.fm brand tokens. The source for packages/tokens in saves-fm/saves (CSS variables for web, a Dart theme for Flutter).

navy.use: Primary brand color. Dark backgrounds, app icon, text on light

navy-deep.use: Page background in dark theme, below navy surfaces

slot.use: Raised surfaces and dividers in dark theme

cloud.use: Text and logo ink on dark backgrounds

mist.use: Page background in light theme, light app icon

mist-line.use: Dividers and borders in light theme

gold.use: Accent on dark: unlocks, the .fm, highlights, primary buttons

gold-deep.use: Accent on light backgrounds (gold fails contrast on light)

periwinkle.use: Secondary marks and muted UI on dark

periwinkle-deep.use: Secondary marks and muted UI on light

display.use: Wordmark, headings, big stat numbers. Short display text only, never body copy

mono.use: Numbers in tables and charts (tabular), console names, codes

logo.clear-space: 2 grid pixels (1/8 of the mark's width) on every side
